title: Nazca and Paracas cranial elongation rituals

tellings.quote: The final thing that the Nazca and Paracas people practiced were cranial deformation or skull elongation rituals.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, discusses two ancient peoples of Peru, the Nazca and the Paracas. He says that one of the things they practised was skull elongation, rituals that reshaped the head to make it long. He raises it in an episode about strange three-fingered bodies found in Peru, as part of the background for weighing what those bodies might be.
